fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD -8.75%) stock declined 10.8% as of 1:20 AM ET on November 13, affected by broad chipmaker sector selloff triggered by competitor Nvidia (NVDA -2.01%) scandal.
fields.summary_ko.1: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned immediately over an ethics scandal, with the first allegation involving a person suspected as a Chinese spy who reportedly facilitated the export of $7.5 billion worth of chips to China.
